PMC/REQUEST_ASSIMILATION_DESC: Hold [{+ping_wheel,+ping,+actionslot 1}] to request to join with ^.&&1^7 nearby enemy operators.
PMC/REQUEST_ASSIMILATION_DETAIL_DESC: We need soldiers that aren't hot heads. Defusing hostile engagements, and cooperating with other teams will prove beneficial for both you and our faction. We want you to try joining together with other teams. A bigger team means more firepower for us.
PMC/REVOLVER_HEADSHOT_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: The revolver is a weapon of a true marksman. Al Mazrah policemen were known to use them as sidearms before AQ took over. Prove to us you know your fundamentals with precision fire on any enemy combatants.
PMC/REVOLVER_HEADSHOT_KILLS_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with headshots using a Basilisk.
PMC/REVOLVER_HEADSHOT_KILLS_LOOT_DESC: Acquire a Basilisk, commonly found in police stations.
PMC/RUN_OVER_REPAIR_DETAIL_DESC: AQ is setting up convoys and patrols along major roadways. We need to impart some psychological warfare to clear the roads for our cargo routes. Use a vehicle to neutralize hostile forces and make it look like it took no damage.
PMC/RUN_OVER_REPAIR_REPAIR_DESC: Fully refuel and repair a vehicle at a gas station.
PMC/RUN_OVER_REPAIR_RUN_DESC: Run over ^.&&1^7 enemies with a vehicle.
PMC/SAM_SHOOT_LOOT_DETAIL_DESC: AQ is using surface-to-air missiles to protect their resupply shipments. Denying AQ these shipments will aid us in our upcoming operation. Your objective is reroute a SAM site to signals intel. We'll target incoming enemy aircraft while you move to secure equipment from the wreckage.
PMC/SAM_SHOOT_LOOT_SHOOT_DESC: Wait for your captured SAM Site to shoot down an airplane.
PMC/SEPT_VEHICLE_KILL_DESC: Destroy ^.7^7 vehicles in close succession ^.&&1^7 times.
PMC/SEPT_VEHICLE_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: A future operation requires that we limit AQ's transportation options. You're tasked with destroying any vehicles in the AO immediately. Hit multiple vehicles in quick succession to minimize any noise that AQ might investigate.
PMC/SHIPPING_MANIFEST_DESC: A shipping manifest for a shipment contracted by Rohan Oil.
PMC/SHOTGUN_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: A local source informed us that AQ found one of our vehicles destroyed in the marshland, claiming we're responsible for a massacre in Ahkdar. We now have two objectives. Clean up the marshlands and neutralize any operators that could be working against us. This isn't a time for discretion. Get close and let them know who sent you.
PMC/SHOTGUN_KILLS_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a Bryson 800 with a Sawed Off Mod in Mawizeh Marsh.
PMC/SHOTGUN_KILLS_MELEE_DESC: Melee kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a Bryson 800 with a Vulture Claw Breacher attached.
PMC/SHOTGUN_KILLS_OPERATORS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a Bryson 800 with 8" XRK CQB Barrel.
PMC/SOLO_INFIL_EXFIL_DETAIL_DESC: Show us you can handle yourself. Infil to the AO and get to extraction - all on your own.
PMC/START_CONTRACT_DESC: Find a contract phone and download the intel.
PMC/STRONGHOLD_CLEAR_SPEEDRUN_CLEAR_DESC: Clear ^.3^7 Strongholds each in under ^.15^7 seconds after unlocking the Stronghold.
PMC/STRONGHOLD_CLEAR_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_DES: Aggressive attack will catch Al-Qatala off guard. Locate strongholds and sweep them fast. Show AQ the speed of violence.
PMC/STRONGHOLD_CLEAR_SPEEDRUN_UNLOCK_DES: Unlock a Stronghold door with a keycard.
PMC/STRONGHOLD_INTEL_DESC: Al-Qatala documents containing names of guards, records of supply deliveries, and communication details.
PMC/SUPPRESSED_ELIM_DETAIL_DESC: Some cartel members are working in Al Mazrah. Eliminate the targets. We pride ourselves on anonymity. Be unseen and unheard.
PMC/SUPPRESSED_ELIM_ELIM_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 Eliminate HVT contract targets using suppressed weapons.
PMC/SUPPRESSED_MELEE_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: We need to engage AQ forces without alerting them to what they're fighting against. Maintain silence and the element of surprise. They more unknown loses they take, the more they'll be pressured to mobilize their units away from our targets.
PMC/SUPPRESSED_MELEE_KILLS_SMG_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a suppressed Fennec 45 with a Fennec Double Tap Mod attached.
PMC/SYNC_SAMSITE_CONTROL_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala SAM sites in the area are limiting our aerial options. Secure enough at the same time for our resupply aircraft to land at our FOB.
PMC/SYNC_UAV_CONTROL_DESC: Have ^.5^7 UAV towers active at the same time.
PMC/SYNC_UAV_CONTROL_DETAIL_DESC: We're looking to do some covert investigations on the Al Mazrah river. Al-Qatala is using UAV towers for overwatch in the AO. We need AQ blind as we move in to take samples of the water. Secure multiple UAV towers simultaneously. We'll be waiting on your signal.
PMC/SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_DESC: Documentation detailing the architecture for the utilities, security, and communications for Al-Qatala computer systems.
PMC/TECH_KILLSTREAK_EXTRACTION_DETAIL_DE: Information is power in a combat zone. We need air support and drones to monitor Al Mazrah after a major operation of ours. Find and deliver some encrypted hard drives to us. With the intel you brought back from the fortress sewers, we can decrypt the data to find AQ's weaknesses.
PMC/TECH_KILLSTREAK_EXTRACTION_DRONE_DES: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Recon Drones to any dumpster dead drop.
PMC/TECH_KILLSTREAK_EXTRACTION_UAV_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 UAVs, advanced UAVs or counter UAVs.
PMC/THERMAL_RANGED_SNIPER_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a suppressed MCPR-300 with a Raptor-FVM40 and a SZ 1mW PEQ laser attached at a range of over ^.200m^7.
PMC/THERMAL_RANGED_SNIPER_DETAIL_DESC: We need to thin out our competition with them knowing it's us at play. Equip yourself with a suppressed sniper rifle and engage operators at 200+ meters. The other factions will blame each other for their losses while we push forward with our plans.
PMC/TRACKING_DEVICE_DESC: A device for discretely recording and transmitting GPS positions.
PMC/TRAIN_KILLS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies while on the train.
PMC/TRAIN_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: Learn to see the advantages of any situation. Use the train to eliminate enemies in the AO. Its sound can conceal your shots, and it acts as an escape vehicle to get you out of the area fast.
PMC/TRAP_NO_DAMAGE_DESC: Complete a Raid Weapons Stash contract without taking body damage.
PMC/TRAP_NO_DAMAGE_DETAIL_DESC: We want AQ to know that we are untouchable. Secure a weapons stash unscathed and prove you have what it takes for high stakes operations. They'll be pressured into moving more guards to defend their equipment.
PMC/TRAP_NO_DOWN_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala is hiding their most expensive equipment in weapon stashes they keep protected in their strongholds. A contractee has data on their positions. Take the contract and secure the equipment without taking casualties.
PMC/TRAP_NO_DOWN_END_DESC: Complete a Raid Weapon Stash contract without any teammates being downed.
PMC/TRAP_NO_DOWN_START_DESC: Acquire a Raid Weapon Stash contract.
PMC/TREASURE_HUNT_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We're investigating the nuclear power plant attack. Intel shows there was trace amounts of radiation on a boat docked up north in Taraq. One of our captured AQ members gave up and revealed that the drill used to break into the compound was ditched in a hidden container and that there's two other caches hiding its location. The first one was located west of Taraq in the oasis near the eastern pond. We need to secure that drill as evidence for AQ's involvement in the attack.
PMC/TREASURE_HUNT_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Locate the third Hidden Container and extract the Irradiated Drill found inside.
PMC/TREASURE_HUNT_STORY_FIRST_DESC: Locate and loot the first Hidden Container at the oasis west of Taraq.
PMC/TREASURE_HUNT_STORY_SECOND_DESC: Locate and loot the second Hidden Container.
PMC/TWO_BIRDS_DESTROY_DESC: Destroy ^.&&1^7 reinforcement helicopters in Al-Safwa Quarry.
PMC/TWO_BIRDS_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: That intel you brought back revealed AQ held their helos in the quarry before deploying them over the northwestern mountains. Your objective is now to destroy those vehicles. Make enough noise and they'll send in some birds to reinforce the area. That will be your target of opportunity to take down those reinforcements.
PMC/UNHACKED_LAPTOP_DESC: Laptop of an Al Mazrah political figure.
PMC/UNIQUE_CONTRACTS_DESC: Complete ^.&&1^7 unique contracts in a single deployment.
PMC/UNIQUE_CONTRACTS_DETAIL_DESC: We're gearing up for a major operation against AQ and need some last minute funding from our contractees. Locate and complete a variety of contracts in the AO. Our contractors want to see that we're capable of any task put in front of us.
PMC/UNIQUE_POI_CONTRACTS_DESC: Complete ^.&&1^7 contracts in ^.8^7 unique POIs in one deployment.
PMC/UNIQUE_POI_CONTRACTS_DETAIL_DESC: We're expanding our operations and are trying to secure resources to support ourselves. We need you to take on a high volume of contract work throughout the AO.
PMC/UTILITY_DEADDROP_DETAIL_DESC:
We're setting up a new base of operations 15km northeast of Al Mazrah. This should lower our faction's transport costs in the AO. We're missing a few items and we won't be able to quickly get a supply shipment.

We set up a dumpster dead drop at the junkyard in a village north of the airport and south-east of Al-Sharim Pass. Look in the south-east Quadrant of G5 on your Tac-Map. Deliver screwdrivers, light bulbs and drills to the dumpster dead drop. We contracted some local couriers to bring the items to us as soon as possible.
PMC/UTILITY_DEADDROP_DRILL_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Electric Drill to the Al-Sharim junkyard dead drop.
PMC/UTILITY_DEADDROP_LIGHTBULB_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Light Bulbs to the Al-Sharim junkyard dead drop.
PMC/UTILITY_DEADDROP_SCREWDRIVERS: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Screwdrivers to the dumpster dead drop at the junkyard in the village south-east of Al-Sharim Pass.
PMC/WATER_CAVES_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: One of our drone feeds showed AQ transporting a narcotics shipment through the Sattiq Cave Complex. Whoever they're in contact with could be the ones moving against us. Infiltrate the caves by boat and clear the site. We know an AQ commander left some documents in a temporary shelter in the riverside caves. Bring them back for us and make it look like they were misplaced.
PMC/WATER_CAVES_STORY_ENTER_DESC: Enter the riverside caves in Sattiq Caves by boat.
PMC/WATER_CAVES_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Loot and extract the Smugging Records in the riverside caves in Sattiq Caves.
PMC/WATER_CAVES_STORY_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a Armored Patrol Boat turret in Sattiq Caves.
PMC/WATER_CAVES_STORY_SWAP_DESC: Place Sensitive Documents at the original location of the Smuggling Records in the same deployment.
PMC/WINE_DELIVERY_AGED_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Aged Wine Bottles to any dumpster dead drop.
PMC/WINE_DELIVERY_DETAIL_DESC: You hopefully remember our friend. His supply has run dry and he's asking for a restock. He's looking for a more vintage selection this time.
PMC/WINE_DELIVERY_WINE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Wine Bottles at any dumpster dead drop.
PMC_S2/BIOLAB_USB_DESC: A thumb drive containing confidential information regarding the DRC and the research done at Building 21.
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_INTEL_A_DESC:
K, we think we finally have found a substance worthy of your objective. The <REDACTED> gas has detrimental short-term effects on the lungs, inducing hypoxia within a minute of mild contact. The compound is able to be produced in mass quantities easily, so I'd like to act quickly. I suspect there's a possible antidote too, but I still need to pinpoint exactly the mechanism it acts on the hemoglobin. 

If it is of your convenience I would be happy to have you visit the DRC again and we'll setup a demonstration. I can say with confidence that you'll be impressed.

- Michal
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_INTEL_B_DESC:
We hope the additional funds are enough for the new Core Lab. I know Michal you have been good with these things in the past but this is critically important. Urzikstan is already being overrun by the western groups and time is limited. AQ hasn't kept their end of the bargain well and I've had enough of dealing with their leadership. It's not better in the East either. Our old accident has alerted a certain Shadow Company and we must clean and leave no traces. I entrust that you know the stakes.

- Konni
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_INTEL_C_DESC:
We've received the package and it is exactly as you promised. Our experiments have already begun and already we're seeing a 26% decrease in damage on the subjects protein structures and DNA. Unfortunately on the surface we haven't been able to prevent the burning but it's looking hopeful. 

Not that it's my place, but I'm worried this leads back to us, and ultimately back to my lab. I trust your judgement but those imbeciles don't know a thing about <REDACTED>. One slip up and the eyes of every nation will be on your group. 

- Michal
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_INTEL_DESC: Documents and letters covering various operations within the DRC as a whole. The majority are of Russian origin, with a select few in English and Arabic.
PMC_S2/BLACK_MOUS_HARDDRIVE_DESC: A specially encrypted hard drive containing a code injection attack to download data from connected servers.
PMC_S2/CEO_LAPTOP_DESC: One of the laptops used by an Ashika Island government official.
PMC_S2/CROWN_INTEL_DESC: These documents don't reveal much. There is official documentation of Crown's legitimacy as a business and organization within the UK. There are trade reports of their involvement with various international entities, with a high concentration in Europe, Africa, and East Asia. Their listed work and employment seems thoroughly detailed though there's a surprising amount of revenue and cash flow for the work they do.
PMC_S2/DRIVERS_NOTE_DESC:
I don't know who it was, they weren't AQ, they sounded like they were speaking Russian. And the equipment they were using I know I haven't seen anything like that. I received the package from the drop off point in the sunken village. I was driving the package through Sarrif Bay and no the AQ guards didn't seem suspicious of me.
Nearing the bridge to Ahkdar shots were fired rapidly at my car. They didn't stop even when I announced that I was a civilian.
I got away leaving the car and package behind. I ran back to Sarrif Bay and met the AQ members who heard the shots. By the time they ran over to the attack site the shooters were gone and the car was destroyed, package included.
PMC_S2/EXPERIMENT_HARDDRIVE_DESC: An encrypted hard drive containing a copy of some data from the DRC.
PMC_S2/FAKE_AQ_INTEL_DESC: Documents discussing AQ's involvement in the Ashika and Al Mazrah cargo ships and how they were used for trafficking drugs to the cartel and throughout East Asia.
PMC_S2/KONNI_DEAL_NOTE_DESC:
Good regards,

I hope this becomes the beginning of a long and mutually beneficial relationship. I understand your group is in need of funds. As it happens I am in need of labour. The kind your group is known for. I will speak of the details in person, but I assume you already know of the type of work involved with our group. I am currently stationed near Al Mazrah. Meet me.

K
PMC_S2/KONNI_INTEL_DESC: Pages full of photographs, documents, transcriptions, and letters involving a Russian group named Konni. There are many horrific tragedies attibuted to the largely unknown organization. While there's no substantial evidence linking any real events to Konni, there are many doubtful ties with events across the globe and through every imaginable form of warfare. There is no known form of how or where they operate. There's no information on any current or former operatives. All that is truly known is their existence.
PMC_S2/KONNI_LAPTOP_DESC: A normal looking laptop. It looks brand new.
PMC_S2/LEGION_DEAL_INTEL_DESC:
We've negotiated with them for a better price for the Kastovs, but I'm getting worried about their interest in the drugs and the oil. They seem like they know too much about our trade and I suspect they are keeping their hands close. None the matter, they offer what we need so the deal is beneficial. I just ask for you to stay on guard around them.

- Your Commander
PMC_S2/MEDICAL_INTEL_DESC: Documents containing studies and reports of various radiation poisoning cases. Arabic notes are scribbled across many of the pages. Some pages are from studies from the DRC. Some pages are clearly poor translations. Many are of attempts to block or even cure the effects of high-exposure radiation poisoning.
PMC_S2/PMC_INSTRUCTIONS_DESC:
We killed the hired courier to deliver this confidential message. Our leaders are interested in working for the Konni Group, but I know what happens to those poor bastards. We're gonna give them what they want. First step is to masquerade as Konni. My squadron tracked a civilian taking a laptop from a dead drop, delivering it to the Ashika Island Hotel. We found him dead a day later and I have no doubt as to who's handiwork it was. 

Locate Konni Laptop and dead drop it here.
Dead drop a Building 21 keycard here as well.

-Your trusted legionary
PMC_S2/POLITICIANS_LETTER_DESC:
Hello,
I now write to you since I know you have a way of getting things done. And I have a problem where I need things done. Suffice to say Al-Qatala has not been receptive of my proposal and they have broken our agreement to sell to the cartels. 
Here's the deal. Take the pipeline back. That mean's the oilfields, the caves, and the port. SC gets 15%.
PMC_S2/RESEARCH_INTEL_DESC: Research discussing the studies of and various treatments to Russian gas poisoning. There was a large surge in locals reporting similar symptoms: feeling burning in the lungs and extreme fatigue. It was concluded that the gas acts on the pulmonary capillaries and eventually restricts blood oxidation anywhere from mild to lethal levels. Patients were reported to not recover from exposure for multiple years. In the most extreme cases, civilians experience hypoxia-induced brain damage.
PMC_S2/SABA_SHIPPING_INTEL_DESC: Documents logging the ingoing and outgoing cargo shipments of Al Mazrah. There's a series of documents recording shipments from over 10 years ago, and then a series of documents from the past 5 years. In many shipments to and from Mexico and Russia, the total recorded cargo is light for the size of the ship being used. A series of Russian ships from 14 years ago are recorded to have sunken without definite cause.
PMC_S2/SEALION_HARDDRIVE_DESC: A hard drive containing a record of various security systems of the Ashika Island infrastructure for the power plant, the water treatment facility, and the science center.
PMC_S2/SEALION_INTEL_DESC: Information regarding the general geography and history of Ashika Island. A large amount of the documents are focused on the science center and many printed articles about the lab directors and their funding. There's old news stories of a mysterious disease spreading amongst the population of the island.
PMC_S2/SHADOW_COMPANY_INTEL_DESC: Documents regarding the financial records of Shadow Company and their many front companies in different countries. A large part of the documents record the various agents working for Shadow Company though all personal information has been redacted. It is clear that Shadow Company has been operating at a deficit for around a year taking on multiple liabilities and debts.
PMC_S2/SHADOW_COMPANY_USB_DESC: A thumb drive holding data from a Shadow Company agent.
PMC_S2/SHADOW_DEAL_INTEL_DESC: Here's the updated deal. All of Al Mazrah for 25% of the value of the oil. Accounting for say, 2.500 shadows, that's brings us to still hundreds of thousands of dollars per day in operational profits. Of course that will take time so we negotiated a deal. We receive an initial payment of $500,000 for the funding of our new base outside Al Mazrah. Then we work on just the core locations for the pipeline for only 5% with another 5% for paying off that initial payment. After the rest is under control then it goes from 15% increasing with interest until 25% after 3 years.
PMC_S2/SHADOW_HARDDRIVE_DESC: A hard drive containing data and programs for various database and security operations for a forward operating base.
PMC_S2/SHADOW_LETTER_DESC: Hey Charlie, I'm just gonna handwrite this old school style cause we both know how the superiors would react. We're indeed taking a plane to the FOB and we're gonna want the LZ to be cleared ahead of time. You just secure the area so we can land safely. The last thing I want is a firefight with AQ around a bunch of fuel-filled birds.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_ACTIVATE_UAV_TOWERS_D: Crown has hacked the UAV towers in the AO and they now send their data back to us. Go activate UAV towers in the combat area so that we may examine the data.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_AMMO_DETAIL_DESC: Crown finds itself short of the ammunition it needs to continue our war efforts. Deliver to us the amount of ammunition we need and we will reward you.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_BACKPACKS_DETAIL_DESC: Crown requires its soldiers to be in prime fighting condition, and that means having enough equipment. We are aware that the AO is scattered with backpacks that allow operators to carry more equipment. Find their drop locations in the AO so that we may direct our soldiers there.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_BUY_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC: We have hacked the combat area buy stations such that when operators buy items, the funds are redirected to us. Go and buy items at the buy stations before our hack is discovered.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_CASH_DETAIL_DESC: Our battlefield efforts require additional funding. Bring us cash and we will reward you.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_COMPLETE_CONTRACTS_DE: We have several tasks needing completion in the AO, so we dispersed contracts for you to complete there via radio. Go complete them and report back for a reward.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_DEAD_DROP_DETAIL_DESC: We need to obtain supplies for our field efforts. Thus we are offering a bounty for items placed in AO dead drops.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_DOGTAGS_DETAIL_DESC: We are paying a premium for every proof of kill that you turn in. Bring us dog tags for a reward.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_EXECUTE_OPERATORS_DET: This is a reminder that in the field you must not allow your work for us to be known. The dead tell no tales, so be sure to execute enemy operators that you encounter.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_EXTRACT_WEAPONS_DETAI: We are tracking weapon serial numbers to collect data on arms manufacturers. We will award you a bounty for extracting weapons from the AO.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_GAS_MASKS_DESC: Collect ^.&&1^7 gas masks from loot caches.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_GAS_MASKS_DETAIL_DESC: We find that gas masks are an excellent way for our operators to conceal their identities. We need to know where the gas masks are in the AO. Go there and find gas masks.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_KILL_AGENTS_DETAIL_DE: We have been receiving threats from paramilitary agents in the field. They are overstepping their boundaries. Go clean a few of them up and show them where their place is.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_KILL_AGENTS_EXPLOSIVE: We are offering a reward for killing enemy agents in the field with explosive devices. Go kill enemy agents with explosives and report back to us for compensation.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_KILL_BOSSES_DETAIL_DE: Crown is trying to gain territory in the field, but enemy commanders are in their strongholds blocking our efforts. Go dispose of them and report back to us for a reward.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_KILL_OPERATORS_DETAIL: We are offering a bounty for killing operators in the field.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_OPEN_CONTAINERS_DETAI: We are conducting a large-scale survey of the combat area to try to determine where technology-related loot is most likely to be found. Help us collect data by opening loot caches in the field.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_PLATE_CARRIERS_DESC: Collect ^.&&1^7 plate carriers from loot caches.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_PLATE_CARRIERS_DETAIL: Our operatives require armor. Scour the AO for armor plate carriers so that we may know where to locate them.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_REVIVE_TEAMMATES_DETA: Crown never leaves dead teammates on the field. Revive your downed teammates and return to us for compensation.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_UNLOCK_SAFEHOUSES_DET: Crown needs intel on strongholds in the AO. Unlock strongholds and report your findings back to us.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_ACTIVATE_UAV_TOWERS_: Phalanx needs to collect intel on where enemies are in the AO so that we may engage them with lethal force. Activating UAV towers will help us obtain this data. Go activate UAV towers in the AO so that we may examine the data.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_BACKPACKS_DETAIL_DES: Phalanx requires its soldiers to be in prime fighting condition, and that means having enough equipment. We are aware that the AO is scattered with backpacks that allow operators to carry more equipment. Find their drop locations in the AO so that we may direct our soldiers there.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_CASH_DETAIL_DESC: We need to raise funds for our field efforts. Return to us cash you have found in the field and we will send you compensation.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_DEAD_DROP_DETAIL_DES: We need to obtain supplies for our field efforts. Thus we are offering a bounty for items placed in AO dead drops.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_EXECUTE_OPERATORS_DE: This is a reminder that in the field you must not allow your work for us to be known. The dead tell no tales, so be sure to execute enemy operators that you encounter.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_EXTRACT_CASE_DETAIL_: Phalanx wants to demonstrate the superiority of its operators to the world. Extract the weapons case from the AO and show the world who is the best.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_EXTRACT_FOOD_DETAIL_: Our soldiers are running short on food supplies. We will reward you for any food supplies delivered to us on exfil.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_EXTRACT_MEDICINE_DET: Our soldiers require medical supplies to keep them alive on the battlefield. Deliver to us any spare medical supplies you find in the field and we will reward you.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_KILL_AGENTS_HEADSHOT: Phalanx is offering a bounty on any enemy agents killed via headshots. Do so and report back to us for a reward.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_KILL_ARMORED_DETAIL_: We have to teach the enemy that they cannot survive, even behind their armor plates. Go destroy enemies with armor plating and show them what our bullets are made of.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_KILL_OPERATORS_DETAI: We are offering a bounty for killing operators in the field.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_OPEN_CONTAINERS_DETA: We are conducting a large-scale survey of the AO to try to determine where weapons-related loot is most likely to be found. Help us collect data by opening loot caches in the field.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_OPEN_SAFE_DETAIL_DES: Phalanx needs intel on what valuable items can be found in safes in the AO. Open a safe and report your findings back to us.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_PLATE_CARRIERS_DETAI: Our elite fighting force requires armor. Scour the AO for armor plate carriers so that we may know where to locate them.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_SAM_SITE_DETAIL_DESC: We need air superiority to cover our agents in the field. Go take enemy SAM sites and make sure we control the skies.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_ACTIVATE_UAV_TOWERS_D: We are offering a bounty for UAV towers activated in the AO.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_AMMO_DETAIL_DESC: We believe that reducing the amount of ammunition in the combat zone will reduce the amount of violence there. We will reward you for delivering rounds from the field to us.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_BUY_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC: We have made a deal with the vendors in the AO that proceeds from every valuable item you buy will be donated to our humanitarian effort. Please go buy items using the AO buy stations to support our efforts.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_COMPLETE_CONTRACTS_DE: We have several tasks needing completion in the AO, so we dispersed contracts for you to complete there via radio. Go complete them and report back for a reward.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_DOGTAGS_DETAIL_DESC: We are aware that casualties happen in the field. Please return the dog tags of any killed operators to us so that we may inform their families.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_EXTRACT_FOOD_DETAIL_D: We have identified a famine near the field AO. Please deliver food supply items to us so that we may redirect them to the affected area.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_EXTRACT_MEDICINE_DETA: We want to reduce the fatality rate in the AO. Please secure for us medical supplies so that we may deploy them to areas in need.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_EXTRACT_WEAPONS_DETAI: Our efforts to reduce violence in the combat area would be improved if there were fewer weapons. Please help us by removing weapons from the AO by extract them on exfil.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_GAS_MASKS_DESC: Collect ^.&&1^7 gas masks from loot caches.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_GAS_MASKS_DETAIL_DESC: White Lotus has been seeing an increased amount of preventable chemical inhalation injuries in our operators. We want to help by identifying where our operators can find gas masks. Please help by locating gas masks in the AO.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_KILL_AGENTS_DETAIL_DE: Enemy factions are recruiting at an alarming rate. We need to thin their numbers. White Lotus is offering a bounty on any enemy agent killed in the field.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_KILL_ARMORED_DETAIL_D: White Lotus has detected a worrisome increase in activity of armored enemies in the field. We need to thin their numbers. White Lotus is offering a bounty on any armored enemies killed in the field.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_KILL_BOSSES_DETAIL_DE: Enemy commanders in the field have been obstructing our attempts to provide humanitarian assistance to the region. Once they have been removed we can move in.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_KILL_OPERATORS_DETAIL: Enemy field operators employed by other factions have been obstructing our attempts to provide humanitarian assistance to the region. Kill them so that we can assist the civilians in the area.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_PLATE_CARRIERS_DESC: Collect ^.&&1^7 plate carriers from loot caches.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_PLATE_CARRIERS_DETAIL: We want to improve the survival rate of our agents in the field. Please search the AO for armor plate carriers so that we may know where to locate them.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_REVIVE_TEAMMATES_DETA: We want all of our operatives to come back alive. Revive your teammates and we will offer you a bounty.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_SELL_VALUABLES_DETAIL: We have made a deal with the vendors in the AO that proceeds from every valuable item you sell will be donated to our humanitarian effort. Please go sell items using the AO buy stations to support our efforts.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_UNLOCK_SAFEHOUSES_DET: One of the rival factions is attempting to falsely accuse us of nefarious deeds. We think some of their leaders are holed up in strongholds in the AO. Please raid those strongholds and disrupt their dishonest activities.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_BACKPACKS_DETAIL_DESC: Black Mous is aware that there are various backpacks available to find in the AO. Locate these backpacks and return to us for a bounty.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_BUY_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC: We have hacked the AO buy stations such that when operators buy items, the funds are redirected to us. Go and buy items at the buy stations before our hack is discovered.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_CASH_DETAIL_DESC: Our battlefield efforts require additional funding. Bring us cash and we will reward you.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_DEAD_DROP_DETAIL_DESC: We need to obtain supplies for our field efforts. Thus we are offering a bounty for items placed in AO dead drops.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_DOGTAGS_DETAIL_DESC: We are looking for intel on field operators that we can use to blackmail rival factions. Bring us dog tags of defeated enemy operators so that we can find their connections to whatever factions they are working for.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_EXTRACT_CASE_DETAIL_DE: We have intel that intel containing dirt about the corrupt leaders of White Lotus has been hidden in the weapon case in the AO. Secure it for us to assist in our efforts to blackmail them.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_EXTRACT_FOOD_DETAIL_DE: The hypocrites in the leadership of White Lotus have been interfering with our online activities. We hear they are trying to obtain food supplies in the AO. Deny them their food supplies by delivering them to us instead.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_EXTRACT_MEDICINE_DETAI: The hypocrites at White Lotus are trying to steal medical supplies from the AO. We want to disrupt their corrupt plans. Extract the medical supplies from the area before their operators can locate them.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_EXTRACT_WEAPONS_DETAIL: We are tracking weapon serial numbers to collect data on arms manufacturers. We will award you a bounty for extracting weapons from the AO.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_KILL_AGENTS_DETAIL_DES: We have been receiving threats from paramilitary agents in the field. They are overstepping their boundaries. Go clean a few of them up and show them where their place is.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_KILL_AGENTS_EXPLOSIVES: We are offering a reward for killing enemy agents in the field with explosive devices. Go kill enemy agents with explosives and report back to us for compensation.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_KILL_AGENTS_HEADSHOTS_: Black Mous is offering a reward for enemy agents killed via headshots. Go do so and report back to us for compensation.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_KILL_BOSSES_DETAIL_DES: Enemy commanders are obstructing our efforts in the field. Kill them and return to us for a reward.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_OPEN_CONTAINERS_DETAIL: We are conducting a large-scale survey of the combat area to try to determine where intelligence-related loot is most likely to be found. Help us collect data by opening loot caches in the field.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_OPEN_SAFE_DETAIL_DESC: Black Mous needs intel on what valuable items can be found in safes in the AO. Open a safe and report your findings back to us.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_REVIVE_TEAMMATES_DETAI: The Black Mous Code stipulates that you should never leave a teammate injured on the field. We intend to reward operators who adhere to our code.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_SAM_SITE_DETAIL_DESC: Legion's air support is disrupting our agents in the AO. Capture SAM sites and clear the skies so our agents can move freely.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_SELL_VALUABLES_DETAIL_: We have hacked the AO buy stations such that when operators sell items, that item is redirected to us. Go and sell items at the buy stations before our hack is discovered.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_UNLOCK_SAFEHOUSES_DETA: Black Mous needs intel on strongholds in the AO. Unlock strongholds and report your findings back to us.
PMC_S3/SHOPKEEPER_INTEL_DESC:
AQ and the cartel have discovered our work. There's some evidence in those bunkers that needs to be destroyed, and we can't have it traced back to us. Anything related to the nuclear testing or gas is to be dispatched. See that the evidence is destroyed. We'll be expecting you to work quickly.

- K
PMC_S4/AQ_BUNKER_NOTE_NOTE:
[In Arabic]

1. Meet the Mexicans at the port.
2. Get a good deal for C4 and Kastovs. (Use oil as leverage if needed)
3. Accompany them to the bunker entrance.
4. Get inside and find the objective.
PMC_S4/BIOLABS_EVIDENCE_NOTE:
[In Russian]
These tunnels have proven useful for our work and as such I propose to you a new center for our work back in the homeland. Transportation costs are going to bury us at this rate, and a modern center for science will aid in our future plans. We can build a compound of research buildings, each of which is seemingly innocent from the outside. We just need to ensure they don't exist on any public records. And then underground we will build a large connecting series of tunnels where our real work can commence.

- Michal
PMC_S4/BUNKER_BLUEPRINTS_DESC: A Russian folder of documents describing the logistical layout of a bunker under Al Mazrah.
PMC_S4/FLARE_STICK_DESC: A small, light stick that can be ignited to mark an area with light and smoke.
PMC_S4/KEYPAD_ROOM_INTEL_DESC: A series of documents describing the chemical formulations of the Russian gas.
PMC_S4/PHALANX_HARD_DRIVE_DESC: A hard drive provided by Phalanx.
PMC_S4/RUSSIAN_DOCS_DESC: Documents tying Konni to Bio Bunker.
PMC_S4/SHADOW_COMPANY_LAPTOP_DESC: A laptop owned by Shadow Company.
PMC_S5/BUYSTATION_KILLSTREAK_DETAIL_DESC: We have secured and authorized payment for heavy artillery at the nearest buy station. Bring the appropriate amount of funds and take out enemy forces in the area.
PMC_S5/BUYSTATION_KILLSTREAK_PURCHASED_D: Purchase ^.&&1^7 killstreaks from a buy station.
PMC_S5/CLEAN_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies without taking damage from them.
PMC_S5/CLEAN_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: We are losing several soldiers in skirmishes with the enemy forces. We need your squad to carefully dispose of enemy soldiers.
PMC_S5/COMPOUND_KILL_LOCATION_DETAIL_DES: Enemy forces have strengthened across the globe. We need your team to take them out.
PMC_S5/CONTRACT_DESTROY_SITES_DETAIL_DES: Several locations have been taken over by enemy forces. We need you to destroy these sites.
PMC_S5/CONTRACT_HOSTAGE_RESCUE_DETAIL_DE: We have seen an uptick in hostages taken under enemy forces. We need your squad to secure and rescue these hostages.
PMC_S5/CONTRACT_LOCATION_DETAIL_DESC: We have accumulated several international jobs. Fufill these contracts and secure payment.
PMC_S5/CONTRACT_SECURE_INTEL_DETAIL_DESC: An unknown enemy has been operating across the globe and we need your team to secure intel and provide us information on their plans.
PMC_S5/CONTRACT_SECURE_SUPPLIES_DETAIL_D: An abundance of enemy supplies are being traced back to the cartel. We need you to secure these supplies.
PMC_S5/CONTRACT_WEAPON_STASH_DETAIL_DESC: We have seen an uptick in enemy weapons being hoarded. We need you to disrupt and secure these supplies.
PMC_S5/DAILY_ASSIMILATE_DETAILED_DESC: We need you to share intel with other enemy squads. Get out there and try not to kill each other.
PMC_S5/DAILY_CLEAR_STRONGHOLD_DETAIL_DES: Our opposition has a strategic advantage with multiple strongholds in the A.O. We need you to eliminate any targets on site.
PMC_S5/DAILY_COMPLETE_CONTRACTS_DETAIL_D: We're at a loss for cash. Complete some contracts for us and bring us back any objectives you earn.
PMC_S5/DAILY_DEAD_DROP_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC: Our supply lines are tight. We have some objectives we need secured. Bring the targets to a designated dead drop.
PMC_S5/DAILY_EXTRACT_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC: We need certain objectives extracted out of the A.O. Our birds will be waiting for you.
PMC_S5/DAILY_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: Our opposition is gaining space and we need you to take it back. Get out there and show us what you can do with a weapon in hand.
PMC_S5/DAILY_KILL_REINFORCEMENT_HELIS_SA: Destroy ^.&&1^7 reinforcement helicopters in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S5/DAILY_KILL_REINFORCEMENT_HELIS_SE: Destroy ^.&&1^7 reinforcement helicopters on Ashika Island.
PMC_S5/DAILY_KILLS_BIOBUNKER_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in the Koschei Complex.
PMC_S5/DAILY_KILLS_RANGED_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies from a range of over ^.50^7 meters.
PMC_S5/DAILY_KILLS_SNIPER_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with marksman rifles or snipers.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_ATTACHED_WEAPONS_DESC: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 weapons with five attachments.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_ATTACHED_WEAPONS_DETAIL_: We have seen reports of weapons being captured by enemy forces. We need these weapons out of the hands of our enemies.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_BACKPACKS_DETAIL_DESC: We are noticing an alarming amount of illicit items being smuggled by enemy forces via backpacks. Deliver backpacks to dead drops to prevent them from being used by the enemy.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_CASH_ALMAZRAH_DESC: Dead drop $^.&&1^7 in cash in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_CASH_ASHIKA_DESC: Dead drop $^.&&1^7 in cash on Ashika Island.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_CASH_BIOLAB_DESC: Dead drop $^.&&1^7 in cash in Building 21.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_CASH_BIOLAB_DETAIL_DESC: Graves has instructed us to reduce the cash reserves of Building 21. Please dead drop any cash you find in Building 21.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_CASH_DETAIL_DESC: We have been asked by several local governments to track the exorbitant amount of money being funneled through terrorist organizations. We have secured several dead drop locations where this cash can be deposited and traced.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_CASH_VONDEL_DESC: Dead drop $^.&&1^7 in cash in Vondel.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_COMPUTERS_DETAIL_DESC: We have secured intelligence that there is potentially a new weapons simulation program located on various pieces of tech strewn across the area. We need you to secure this information.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_GAS_CANS_DETAIL_DESC: We are running low on fuel for our vehicles. We need you to secure as much gas as you can and provide it at the nearest dead drop.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_PHOTOS_DESC: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 pictures of people or pets.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_PHOTOS_DETAIL_DESC: Our organization has been hired to locate missing refugees and families reported missing. We have been tasked with gathering photographs portraying these families.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_VEHICLE_DETAIL_DESC: Some of our vehicles are in desperate need of repair and need supplies to be fixed.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_WEAPONS_LOCATION_ALMAZRA: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 weapons in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_WEAPONS_LOCATION_ASHIKA_: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 weapons on Ashika Island.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_WEAPONS_LOCATION_DETAIL_: We are noticing an abundance of unauthorized weapons around the globe and need to make sure these do not reach enemy hands. Please deposit these at the nearest dead drop and we will make sure they are safely disposed of.
PMC_S5/EXFIL_BIOLAB_DETAIL_DESC: We need more eyes and ears at Building 21 for an investigation. Shadow Company has lost a lot of good soldiers there. We are sending your squad to investigate. Please return alive and in one piece.
PMC_S5/HUNT_SQUAD_BRONZE_DESC: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 bronze dog tags or better.
PMC_S5/HUNT_SQUAD_DETAIL_DESC: Unaffiliated mercernaries have been spotted in the area. We have determined them to be a threat and they have taken out several of our key operators. We need you to take them out and bring their dog tags to confirm the kill.
PMC_S5/HUNT_SQUAD_GOLD_DESC: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 gold dog tag or better.
PMC_S5/HUNT_SQUAD_SILVER_DESC: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 silver dog tags or better.
PMC_S5/KILL_OPERATORS_LOCATION_DETAIL_DE: Unaffiliated operators have been spotted in the area. They could be working with enemy forces and we have authorized that they be taken out.
PMC_S5/KILL_POI_ALMAZRAH_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies at Taraq Village in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S5/KILL_POI_ASHIKA_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies at the Tsuki Castle on Ashika Island.
PMC_S5/KILL_POI_DETAIL_DESC: We have seen an increase of enemy operations at key locations such as the Zoo in Vondel, the Tsuki Castle on Ashika Island, and Taraq Village in Al Mazrah. Neutralize the enemy in these key locations.
PMC_S5/KILL_POI_VONDEL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies at the Zoo in Vondel.
PMC_S5/KILL_SNIPER_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a Sniper Rifle.
PMC_S5/KILL_SNIPER_DETAIL_DESC: Several of our soldiers have directly engaged with the enemy, we need your squad to take out the enemy forces from a distance using a sniper rifle.
PMC_S5/KILL_TURRET_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with an LTV Turret.
PMC_S5/KILL_TURRET_DETAIL_DESC: We have noticed several vehicles equipped with turrets being used by enemy forces. We need you to capture these vehicles and use their own fire power against them.
PMC_S5/KILL_UAV_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies Pinged by a UAV Tower
PMC_S5/KILL_UAV_DETAIL_DESC: We need your squad to provide reconnaissance and at your discretion take out any enemies highlighted in the area.
PMC_S5/KILLS_ALMAZRAH_DETAIL_DESC: We are seeing an uptick in enemy forces in Al Mazrah, we need you to take them out.
PMC_S5/KILLS_ASHIKA_DETAIL_DESC: Ashika Island has been overrun by enemy forces and is disrupting our organization's work. We need your squad to neutralize this threat.
PMC_S5/KILLS_CLOSE_DETAIL_DESC: We have seen a lot of unconfirmed kills and would like you to make sure that your kills are confirmed by being close to the target upon death.
PMC_S5/KILLS_MELEE_DETAIL_DESC: We are running low on guns and ammunition. We need you to use more personal means of taking out your enemies such as knives, riot shields, or swords.
PMC_S5/KILLS_VONDEL_DETAIL_DESC: Vondel is increasingly becoming a hostile place. We need you to disrupt and take out as many enemy combatants as possible to restore some peace.
PMC_S5/MATCH_UAV_DESC: Activate 3 UAV towers per match ^.&&1^7 Times.
PMC_S5/MATCH_UAV_DETAIL_DESC: We need your squad to provide reconnaissance. We have several UAV towers stationed at various locations. Activate these UAV Towers to provide sight on the enemy.
PMC_S5/TRAVEL_POI_UNDAMAGED_DESC: Visit ^.&&1^7 POIs without taking any health damage.
PMC_S5/TRAVEL_POI_UNDAMAGED_DETAIL_DESC: We have lost several squads in recent deployments. We need to assess the situation, please visit several locations and be extremely cautious not to be seen and not to receive fire.
seasonal_event/delta_community_desc: Collect Medals as a community to unlock a new weapon and gameplay elements in Vondel.
SPLASHES/CHALLENGE_CHILD: Use ^55^7 Killstreaks, or earn all ^53^7 Killstreaks in one life
SPLASHES/CHALLENGE_FOX: Punch a vehicle ^510^7 times before it explodes
SPLASHES/CHALLENGE_SECRET2: Get Top ^53^7 in a Battle Royale match
SPLASHES/CHALLENGE_SKUNK: Get ^55^7 Throwing Knife kills in a single match
SPLASHES/CHALLENGE_TEENA: Win a ^52v2^7 match as the top scorer
SPLASHES/CHALLENGE_TEENB: Crouch rapidly over several players after you've killed them
SUPER_CP/ARMORBOX_DESC: Drops a crate of armor plates.
SUPER_CP/SNAPSHOT_PULSE_DESC: Emits a periodic snapshot to detect nearby enemies.
super_mp/suppression_rounds_desc: Gives weapon ammo that applies bonus damage against armored targets; this includes vehicles, equipment, body armor, and targets behind penetrable cover.
vehicles/apc_desc: This amphibious APC can lay down 30mm cannon fire, transport up to 6 squad members to the front line, and serves as a mobile spawn point.
vehicles/atv_desc: Take charge with rough and ready capability delivered with plenty of low-rpm torque and power. Top-tier rack capacity offers an impressive payload capability: hold 'er wide and send it.
vehicles/c130_desc: A heavy assault gunship equipped with a laser tracking missile, along with the standard 40mm and 25mm cannons.
vehicles/cargo_truck_desc: A large industrial vehicle. Slow moving, but may provide a small amount of protection in firefights.
vehicles/jeep_desc: Built and designed without compromise, a spacious interior allows for crew transportation to even the most remote corners of the map. Confident on- or off-road, with the durability to tackle the most extreme of challenges, the SUV can take a beating and keep on ticking.
vehicles/light_tank_desc: A maneuverable tank with a multipurpose turret and light armor.
vehicles/little_bird_desc: A twin-engine light helicopter for combat support and rapid traversal of the engagement zone.
vehicles/tac_rover_desc: The pinnacle of ultra-light tactical off-road vehicles, allowing rapid personnel deployment for squads of up to four. Go deep and hard in the most rugged and austere environments with world-class mobility and versatility.
vehicles/vehicle_horn_mountainking: In the Hall of the Mountain King
vehicles/vehicle_horn_toccata: Toccata and Fugue in D minor
WEAPON/COUNTERWEIGHT_DESC: Modified FHR40 scanned in Geneva which has built-in reduced recoil.
WEAPON/REPEATER_DESC: Modified R.A.W. with an increased ammo capacity. Headshot kills will refill the clip.
xboxlive/mpnotallowed: The current profile is not allowed to play online.
xboxlive/netconnection: No network connection detected. You must have an active network connection to play online or over a local network.
xboxlive/signedoutoflive: You must be signed in to Battlenet to play online matches.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/ALTERNATE_CURRENT_DESC_: Hit ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^10^7 Mercenaries with Tesla Storm Field Upgrade.
Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^50^7 Zombies affected by Tesla Storm Field Upgrade.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/ALTERNATE_CURRENT_SUMMA: For Operation Deadbolt to execute the next phase of its counter-offensive plan, there's more shaping operations to perform. The team makes use of tools that will expedite this process.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/ASCENSION_DESC_1: Use a Redeploy Drone to free fall or parachute to a different Threat Zone.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/ASCENSION_DESC_2: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^10^7 Zombies while ascending a Redeploy Drone.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/ASCENSION_SUMMARY: Jansen is taking stock of the technology Operation Deadbolt has available. Some of it may provide useful components for her prototype Dark Aether-neutralizing device. Dobbs invites her to sit in while he oversees Redeploy Drone training.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/BLASTED_DESC_1: Obtain a Shatter Blast Ammo Mod.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/BLASTED_DESC_2: Destroy armor on ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^25^7 Zombies using Shatter Blast Ammo Mod.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/BLASTED_SUMMARY: An armored corpse has been spotted carrying a Terminus Outcomes tablet. Fearing it may be one of Jansen's cyphers, Corporal Miller lends her expertise in deadhead disposal.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/BOMBERMAN_DESC_1: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^25^7 Zombies with the Energy Mine Field Upgrade.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/BOMBERMAN_DESC_3_R1: Stop a Mercenary Convoy with the Energy Mine Field Upgrade.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/BOMBERMAN_SUMMARY: Terminus Outcomes is getting far too comfortable in the EZ. Soap tasks the Strike Team with deploying Energy Mines to compromise the safety of the mercenaries' routes.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/BOUNTY_HUNTER_DESC_1: Complete a Big Bounty Contract for a Mangler.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/BOUNTY_HUNTER_DESC_2: Complete a Big Bounty Contract for a Disciple.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/BOUNTY_HUNTER_DESC_3: Complete a Big Bounty Contract for a Mimic.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/BOUNTY_HUNTER_SUMMARY: The variety of Dark Aether lifeforms in the EZ means there are many unique properties that Jansen's device will have to neutralize. She sends the team out to obtain a new batch of tissue samples for her testing.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/BRINGEMON_DESC_1: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^50^7 Zombies with Frenzied Guard Field Upgrade active.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/BRINGEMON_DESC_2_R1: Kill a Special or Elite enemy with Frenzied Guard Field Upgrade active.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/BRINGEMON_SUMMARY: Another would-be PMC defector, trusted with one of Jansen's tablets, is facing a swarm of undead mercenaries. Ravenov takes command of the recovery team.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/CHAPERONE_DESC_2: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^75^7 Zombies during a single Escort Contract.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/CHAPERONE_SUMMARY: Terminus Outcomes have been inflicting high levels of attrition against Operation Deadbolt equipment. Kapoor needs the team to take good care of an ACV on an essential Escort mission.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/CLOSING_TIME_DESC_2: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^50^7 Zombies inside the Aether Storm.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/CLOSING_TIME_DESC_3: Defeat Stormcaller inside the Aether Storm.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/CLOSING_TIME_SUMMARY: Hoping to uncover a way to increase the power output of her neutralizer device, Dr. Jansen asks the team to head into the heart of an Aether Storm and observe the behavior of a particular being - one that Strauss believed to be the instigator of the terrifying phenomenon.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/CRASH_AND_BURN_SUMMARY: Enemy helo patrols are impeding Deadbolt recon efforts to find the research that Dr. Jansen needs to continue her work. The team's orders are clear - take out those birds.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/DEFEAT_ZAKHAEV_SUMMARY: This is it. Dr. Jansen's machine is complete. The team assaults Zakhaev and Fletcher's central base of operations, aiming to rid him of his most potent weapon - and hopefully put an end to the Incursion once and for all...
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/DIRECT_LINE_DESC_1: Ping a Contract in the Tac Map.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/DIRECT_LINE_SUMMARY: No time to waste. The team heads out into the EZ to begin containment measures. Deadbolt's drone pilot, Captain Lucas Dobbs, conducts a crash course on navigation and threat indicators.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/ESSENCE_OF_AETHER_DESC_: Collect the Essence Sample from the container in Hamza Bazaar at Hadiqa Farms.
Collect the Essence Sample from the container in Rostova Shops at Levin Resort.
Collect the Essence Sample from the container in Quadri Shopping Center at Zaravan City.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/ESSENCE_OF_AETHER_SUMMA: Thinking ahead, Jansen goes on the hunt for a test site for her prototype. She tasks the team with recovering samples of Essence from different areas in the EZ.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/EXTERMINATOR_DESC_2: Complete the Contract in under 2 minutes and 30 seconds.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/EXTERMINATOR_DESC_3: Obtain Rare Aether Tool Schematic and Exfil.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/EXTERMINATOR_SUMMARY: Based on alarming data received from Barrera, Greene wants to destroy as many Aether Spores as possible before they turn into something worse.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/EXTRACTION_STEP3: Defend Ava while data is uploaded.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/EXTRACTION_STEP4: Bring Dr. Jansen in for questioning.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/EXTRACTION_SUMMARY: With Dr. Jansen finally located, the Strike Team travels deep into Terminus Outcomes-held territory. The mission: get in and bring the scientist home. Greene has questions for her.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/FIREPOWER_DESC_1: Pack-a-Punch a weapon to Level I.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/FIREPOWER_DESC_2_R1: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^50^7 Zombies with a Level I Pack-A-Punched weapon.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/FIREPOWER_SUMMARY: SSO Greene advises the recruits to get familiar with the experimental ammunition mods available to Operation Deadbolt.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/FIRESTARTER_DESC_1: Ignite ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^50^7 Zombies with Napalm Burst Ammo Mod.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/FIRESTARTER_DESC_2: Ignite ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^5^7 Special Zombies with Napalm Burst Ammo Mod.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/FIRESTARTER_SUMMARY: The  high density of hostiles in the EZ is preventing Deadbolt search teams from deploying. The squad heads out to wrangle the local residents and clean house.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/FREEZEBURN_DESC_1: Slow ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^50^7 Zombies with Cryo Freeze Ammo Mod.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/FREEZEBURN_DESC_2: Slow ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^10^7 Hellhounds with Cryo Freeze Ammo Mod.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/FREEZEBURN_SUMMARY: Ahead of any major troop movements, Miller suggests a novel method of clearing a path for the advancing force.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/FROST_BITE_DESC_1: Freeze ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^50^7 Zombies with Frost Blast Field Upgrade.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/FROST_BITE_DESC_2: Freeze ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^5^7 Mimics with Frost Blast Field Upgrade.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/FROST_BITE_SUMMARY: Jansen is getting close to finishing her prototype, but the war goes on. Miller keeps the team on their toes by requesting a report on the effectiveness of Frost Blast in the field.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/GAMBLER_DESC_1: Purchase a weapon from a Mystery Box.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/GAMBLER_DESC_2: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^50^7 Zombies with a Mystery Box weapon.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/GAMBLER_SUMMARY: Specialist Ravenov gives the squad a quick rundown on the use of the "Mystery Box" - one of the more useful pieces of hardware to fall out of the Dark Aether.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/GHOSTED_DESC_1: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^100^7 Zombies with Aether Shroud Field Upgrade activated.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/GHOSTED_DESC_2: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^20^7 Mercenaries with Aether Shroud active.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/GHOSTED_SUMMARY: Ravenov wants the team to carve out a kill box for Terminus Outcome's best and brightest. His commands: quell the undead locals and create an illusory path of least resistance for the mercenaries to take.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/GUARDIAN_ANGEL_DESC_1: Heal Operators ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^20^7 times with Healing Aura Field Upgrade.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/GUARDIAN_ANGEL_SUMMARY: Dobbs advises that Deadbolt has been losing personnel in the field and new protocols are being put in place. With Dr. Jansen observing, the squad sets out to aid their endangered teammates.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/HANDS_OFF_SUMMARY: The race to locate the would-be Terminus Outcomes defector is on. The mercs are in possession of a portion of her cypher. Kapoor takes over as the squad moves to recover the cypher before Terminus can return it to their command.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/HOLDOUT_DESC_2: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^50^7 Zombies inside the corrupted space.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/HOLDOUT_SUMMARY: Dr. Jansen admits that her prototype device was a hammer where a scalpel was needed. To more efficiently calibrate her next version, she sends the team to collect incredibly accurate measurements of Phase Crystals on the brink of their dissolution.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/INFILTRATOR_DESC_4: Retrieve Terminus Outcomes Record from the Stronghold Safe.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/INFILTRATOR_SUMMARY: Applying pressure to Terminus Outcomes has paid off. A clear path of attack opens to the Stronghold where the intercepted convoy was headed. Soap takes command as the squad moves to capture the facility and uncover the PMC's plans.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/INTERCEPT_CONVOY_DESC_2: Collect Stronghold Keycard dropped by Mercenary Convoy.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/INTERCEPT_CONVOY_SUMMAR: Training day's over. One of Dobbs' drones has located a Terminus Outcomes convoy moving something valuable. Greene assembles a team to intercept it and recover the cargo.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/ITS_A_TRAP_DESC_1: Activate ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^3^7 Deadbolt Turrets with Ammo Mod Circuit Boards.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/ITS_A_TRAP_SUMMARY: Chief Mechanic Kapoor needs a Strike Team to conduct service and repair operations on Auto Turrets across the Exclusion Zone. Once operational, Terminus Outcomes' movement will be restricted, freeing up hands for Operation Deadbolt.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/MERC_CLEANUP_SUMMARY: Greene has intel on a merc plan to take out Ava. She orders the squad to raid several camps nearby that might make good bases for such an operation.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/MIND_CONTROL_DESC_1: Turn ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^20^7 Zombies with Brain Rot Ammo Mod.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/MIND_CONTROL_DESC_2: Allow ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^25^7 Zombies to be killed by turned Zombies.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/MIND_CONTROL_SUMMARY: There's no guarantee that Dr. Jansen's device will be a success. Greene puts in an order for aggressive corpse clean-up in case containment efforts need to continue.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/MORE_FIREPOWER_DESC_1: Pack-a-Punch a weapon to Level II.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/MORE_FIREPOWER_DESC_2: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^75^7 Zombies with a Level II Pack-A-Punched weapon.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/MORE_FIREPOWER_DESC_3: Kill a Special Zombie with a Level II Pack-A-Punched weapon.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/MORE_FIREPOWER_SUMMARY: The infusion of Dark Aether energies into Deadbolt weapons has caught Jansen's attention. Seeing augmented weaponry in action may further guide her design process as the Dark Aether-neutralizing device comes together.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/MOST_FIREPOWER_DESC_1: Pack-a-Punch a weapon to Level III.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/MOST_FIREPOWER_DESC_2: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^100^7 Zombies with Level III Pack-A-Punched weapon.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/MOST_FIREPOWER_DESC_3: Kill a Megabomb with Level III Pack-A-Punched weapon.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/MOST_FIREPOWER_SUMMARY: While Deadbolt's attention has been divided between defensive operations and efforts to locate Dr. Strauss's research, the denizens of the Exclusion Zone have been growing in strength and number. It's time to make a real dent.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/NEST_WRECKER_SUMMARY: Gas masks up. Ravenov guides the team toward another cypher located inside an Aether Nest.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/PAINT_THE_TARGET_DESC_2: Hit a Mercenary Convoy with a Precision Airstrike.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/PAINT_THE_TARGET_DESC_3: Hit a Merc Camp with a Precision Airstrike.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/PAINT_THE_TARGET_SUMMAR: With Terminus Outcomes moving to cut off Operation Deadbolt's lines of supply, Soap wants some hate laid from above. He's got precision airstrikes ready to go. It's time to rain on their parade.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/RAIDERS_OF_LOST_ARMS_SU: Greene wants the team to hit Deadbolt where it hurts - in their weapons stockpiles. No such thing as too much ammo while the hunt continues.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/REAPER_SUMMARY: Barrera wants to show Dr. Jansen what's been coming through from the other side, and how Operation Deadbolt cleans up the mess. Jansen observes as he leads a Harvester Orb hunt.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/RESTOCK_DESC_1: Fully refuel ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^3^7 different vehicles at Gas Stations.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/RESTOCK_SUMMARY: Kapoor is developing a contingency plan for refueling vehicles in the event the assault on the mercenary Stronghold goes sideways. Scout out a few gas stations in the EZ and check how much fuel is left.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/ROAD_RAGE_SUMMARY: Chief Mechanic Color Sergeant Rupinder Kapoor hands over the keys to his fleet of vehicles so that the new members of Operation Deadbolt can go over offensive maneuvers and post-care.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/ROAD_WARRIOR_DESC_1: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^30^7 Zombies by running them over with a vehicle.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/ROAD_WARRIOR_DESC_2: Kill 30 zombies with a vehicle's turret.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SABOTEUR_SUMMARY: Not to be outdone by Soap, Ravenov decides to hit Terminus Outcomes' Aetherium extraction operations. Destroying their equipment will be a costly inconvenience - high casualty rates will be even harder to recover from.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SAFE_CRACKER_DESC_1: Complete a Raid Weapon Stash Contract.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SAFE_CRACKER_DESC_2: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^30^7 Zombies attracted by the safe drill.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SAFE_CRACKER_DESC_3: Do not allow the safe drill to pause.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SAFE_CRACKER_SUMMARY: Hoping to smooth over any questions regarding her loyalty, Jansen proves the location of a safe where Terminus Outcomes keeps their security details. The sooner the contents of this safe are procured, the better.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SAME_DAY_DELIVERY_DESC_: Destroy the enemy helicopter chasing the Cargo Delivery vehicle.
Destroy the Cargo Delivery vehicle after contract completion.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SAME_DAY_DELIVERY_SUMMA: Now that Dr. Jansen is in Deadbolt's hands, she'll need a lab set up to get to work. Greene decides to twist the knife further by stealing Terminus Outcomes lab equipment.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SHEPHERD_SUMMARY: Dr. Jansen's prototype has passed its commissioning tests with flying colors. The Strike Team escorts the precious device to a site deep within the EZ to conduct final tests. If this goes well, it could change everything.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SHOCKED_DESC_1: Stun ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^25^7 Zombies with Dead Wire Ammo Mod.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SHOCKED_DESC_2: Stun ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^5^7 Special Zombies with Dead Wire Ammo Mod.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SHOCKED_SUMMARY: Jansen is working on providing power to her prototype. She asks for a demonstration of Dead Wire in case it can be repurposed for her needs.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SIPHON_AETHER_DESC2: Collect a filled Essence Container from an Aether Extractor.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SIPHON_AETHER_TITLE_SUM: Busting up a Terminus Outcomes mining operation will not only keep Aetherium off the black market, but also yield enough material for Dr. Jansen's tests. Ravenov and Soap orchestrate the robbery.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SPRING_CLEANING_DESC_1: Clear an Infested Stronghold in the High Threat Zone.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SPRING_CLEANING_DESC_2: Collect ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^3^7 Intel Tablets from Infested Strongholds
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/SPRING_CLEANING_SUMMARY: Jansen needs confirmation on some of Strauss's theories about the nature of the Dark Aether's spread. This could get messy.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/STORM_THE_CASTLE_SUMMAR: Strauss's research is finally in sight. Unfortunately, Zakhaev has entrusted it to one of Fletcher's most trusted lieutenants for safekeeping. The team moves out to get the job done.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/TREASURE_HUNTER_SUMMARY: Corporal Krystal Miller reminds us that Operation Deadbolt's budget isn't infinite. She instructs the new recruits on where to find supplemental supplies while out in the field.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/TWO_FACTOR_AUTHENTICATI: Zakhaev, aware of Deadbolt's plans, starts to move offensively. Barrera has suggested that his seismic detectors could be augmented to detect enemy movements, and Greene eagerly puts that theory to the test.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/WALL_POWER_DESC_1: Purchase a weapon from a Wall Buy.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/WALL_POWER_DESC_2: Kill ^?#x07dbb8c7ca3aeb214.#x0ca17dafe42e7b78f^50^7 Zombies with a Wall Buy weapon.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/WALL_POWER_SUMMARY: The Operation Deadbolt recruits learn to balance budget and firepower under the watchful eye of Quartermaster Corporal Miller, who explains the function of the mysterious "Wall Buys" that have appeared across the Exclusion Zone.
ZOMBIE_CHALLENGE/WHERES_AVA_SUMMARY: With the cyphers cracked, Deadbolt is once again on Dr. Jansen's trail. They head to the specified location to deal with all threats and take Jansen into custody.
